S.FORM: 'uvaaz hai mapasnava mapatas.
'uvaaz hai mapasnava mapatas.
S.TRANSL: 小孩學習寫字。
The child learns how to write.

FORM.notes: source note: nii uvaaz ma-pasnava ma-patas

S.FORM: 'uvaaz hai nii tu mapasnava mapatas.
'uvaaz hai nii tu mapasnava mapatas.
S.TRANSL: 小孩不學習寫字。
The child doesn't learn how to write.

FORM.notes: source note: adu ma-pasnava uvaaz ma-patas

S.FORM: 'uvaaz hai adu mapasnava mapatas.
'uvaaz hai adu mapasnava mapatas.
S.TRANSL: 孩子學習寫字嗎。
Does the child learn how to write?

S.FORM: tama hai mazima mapasnava.
tama hai mazima mapasnava.
S.TRANSL: 爸爸喜歡學習。
Father likes to study.

S.FORM: nii tama mazima mapasnava.
nii tama mazima mapasnava.
S.TRANSL: 爸爸不喜歡學習。
Father doesn't like to learn.

S.FORM: adu mazima tama mapasnava.
adu mazima tama mapasnava.
S.TRANSL: 爸爸喜歡學習嗎。
Does father like to learn?

S.FORM: masnanava hai muampuk palihansiap mapatas kiliuku.
masnanava hai muampuk palihansiap mapatas kiliuku.
S.TRANSL: 老師開會討論一些研究知識並做紀錄。
The teachers discuss and take notes.

FORM.notes: source note: nii masnanava muanpu palihansiap ma-patas kiliuku

S.FORM: masnanava hai nii tu muampuk palihansiap mapatas kiliuku.
S.PHON: masnanava [x|χ]ai nii tu muampuk pa[l|ɬ]i[x|χ]anɕiap mapatas ki[l|ɬ]iuku
S.FORM: masnanava hai nii tu muampuk palihansiap mapatas kiliuku.
S.PHON: masnanava [x|χ]ai nii tu muampuk pa[l|ɬ]i[x|χ]anɕiap mapatas ki[l|ɬ]iuku
S.TRANSL: 老師沒有開會討論一些研究知識也沒有做紀錄。
The teachers don't discuss and take notes.

S.FORM: adu muampuk masnanavaa palihansiap musasu mapatas kiliuku.
S.PHON: adu muampuk masnanavaa pa[l|ɬ]i[x|χ]anɕiap musasu mapatas ki[l|ɬ]iuku
S.FORM: adu muampuk masnanavaa palihansiap musasu mapatas kiliuku.
S.PHON: adu muampuk masnanavaa pa[l|ɬ]i[x|χ]anɕiap musasu mapatas ki[l|ɬ]iuku
S.TRANSL: 今天老師開會順便寫筆記嗎。
Does the teacher discuss and take notes?

FORM.notes: source note: 前提是老師有張紙，我有瓶水，桌上有副眼鏡 | source note: 戴也可以是項鍊haulus | source note: pa-dangi-an migani 戴眼鏡 | source note: Ibu hai kilim sai-cia 沒有前提的話，不知道是什麼東西 | source note: Ibu hai kilim sai-ciin Ibu在找水（距離話者最近的那個東西） | source note: Ibu hai kilim sai-taan Ibu在找水和紙（周遭的東西都可以包含進來）

S.FORM: Ibu hai mapadangi patmata huud mas danum kilim mas ahil.
S.PHON: ibu [x|χ]ai mapadaŋi patmata [x|χ]uud mas danum ki[l|ɬ]im mas a[x|χ]i[l|ɬ]
S.FORM: Ibu hai mapadangi patmata huud mas danum kilim mas ahil.
S.PHON: ibu [x|χ]ai mapadaŋi patmata [x|χ]uud mas danum ki[l|ɬ]im mas a[x|χ]i[l|ɬ]
S.TRANSL: Ibu 戴眼鏡，喝水，找紙。
Ibu wore glasses, drank water, and looked for papers.

FORM.notes: source note: 不自然的講法，但是可以明白 | source note: dangian=ik patmata 我戴眼鏡 | source note: na=mapadangi=ik patmata 我要戴眼鏡

S.FORM: Ibu hai mapadangi patmatacia huud mas danumcin kilim mas ahiltan.
S.PHON: ibu [x|χ]ai mapadaŋi patmataʨia [x|χ]uud mas danumʨin ki[l|ɬ]im mas a[x|χ]i[l|ɬ]tan
S.FORM: Ibu hai mapadangi patmatacia huud mas danumcin kilim mas ahiltan.
S.PHON: ibu [x|χ]ai mapadaŋi patmataʨia [x|χ]uud mas danumʨin ki[l|ɬ]im mas a[x|χ]i[l|ɬ]tan
S.TRANSL: Ibu戴那個眼鏡、喝這個水，找這個紙
Ibu wore those glasses, drank this water, and looked for this paper.

FORM.notes: source note: mapinkuang 欺負

S.FORM: Ibu hai mapatangis dangians patmata tu bunun.
S.PHON: ibu [x|χ]ai mapataŋis daŋians patmata tu bunun
S.FORM: Ibu hai mapatangis dangians patmata tu bunun.
S.PHON: ibu [x|χ]ai mapataŋis daŋians patmata tu bunun
S.TRANSL: Ibu把戴眼鏡的人弄哭。
Ibu made a person wearing glasses cry.

FORM.notes: source note: 轉喻

S.FORM: Ibu hai mapatangis patmatacia.
Ibu hai mapatangis patmatacia.
S.TRANSL: Ibu把那個眼鏡仔弄哭了。
Ibu made the one with glasses.

S.FORM: Ibu hai mapadangi isaicia tu patmata.
Ibu hai mapadangi isaicia tu patmata.
S.TRANSL: Ibu 戴他的眼鏡。
Ibu wore his glasses.

FORM.notes: source note: 以下3句一起看; annotation codes removed; consult the NTU Formosan Corpus source

S.FORM: Tahail takna hai isia ludun mapunahtung babuvanis.
Tahail takna hai isia ludun mapunahtung babuvanis.
S.TRANSL: Tahail 昨天在山上遇到山豬。
Tahail ran into a wild boar in the mountain yesterday.

FORM.notes: source note: hanian Tahail hai na=madas bulsu-kavi na=kudii manah sai-cia 和上句一起看，中文和此句一樣

S.FORM: hanian Tahail hai namadas busulkavitan nakudii manah mas babuvaniscia.
S.PHON: [x|χ]anian ta[x|χ]ai[l|ɬ] [x|χ]ai namadas busu[l|ɬ]kavitan nakudii mana[x|χ] mas babuvanisʨia
S.FORM: hanian Tahail hai namadas busulkavitan nakudii manah mas babuvaniscia.
S.PHON: [x|χ]anian ta[x|χ]ai[l|ɬ] [x|χ]ai namadas busu[l|ɬ]kavitan nakudii mana[x|χ] mas babuvanisʨia
S.TRANSL: 今天Tahail要拿這個弓箭去獵那隻山豬。
Today Tahail is going to take the bow and go hunting the wild boar.\

FORM.notes: source note: 因為 =a 可以知道是Subali抓到的那隻山豬 | source note: adii babuvanis hai madaing 那隻山豬很大（指的是在那邊的那個山豬） | source note: ma-daing babu vanis=cia 山豬牙很大，用 =cia 的話是指山豬牙，因為 =cia修飾的是前面的詞， =a 修飾整個名詞組或片語

S.FORM: madaing babuvanisa.
madaing babuvanisa.
S.TRANSL: 那隻山豬很大。
That wild boar is big.

FORM.notes: source note: sai-taan 離話者比較遠的；也可以是聽者正要給的

S.FORM: minaunin saikin saitaan tu bunbun.
minaunin saikin saitaan tu bunbun.
S.TRANSL: 我吃過這個香蕉。
I have eaten this banana (around the speaker).

W.TRANSL: 主焦<完成貌>吃=狀態改變

FORM.notes: source note: sai-ciin 在話者手上

S.FORM: minaunin saikin saiciin tu bunbun.
minaunin saikin saiciin tu bunbun.
S.TRANSL: 我有吃過這個香蕉。
I have eaten this banana (near the speaker).

W.TRANSL: 主焦<完成貌>吃=狀態改變

FORM.notes: source note: sai-cia 那邊（可以是聽者準備拿給話者的） | source note: minaun=in=ik sai-cia tu bunbun. 也可以，一樣的意思

S.FORM: minaunin saikin saicia tu bunbun.
minaunin saikin saicia tu bunbun.
S.TRANSL: 我有吃過那種香蕉。
I have eaten that banana.

W.TRANSL: 主焦<完成貌>吃=狀態改變

FORM.notes: source note: 書本在說話現場，但是離會話事件的人都遠

S.FORM: sadu saicia tu ahil Tanis.
sadu saicia tu ahil Tanis.
S.TRANSL: Tanis看那本書。
Tanis read that book.

FORM.notes: source note: 這邊的 =cia 其實可有可無，總之看得到了

S.FORM: Tahail hai kudii sadu atasipal tu luduncia.
Tahail hai kudii sadu atasipal tu luduncia.
S.TRANSL: Tahail去看對面的山。
Tahail went to see the mountain on the opposite side.

FORM.notes: source note: =tan 表示在近處的帽子

S.FORM: madadaingaz siza andii tu tamuungtan.
madadaingaz siza andii tu tamuungtan.
S.TRANSL: 長老拿這頂帽子。
The elder took this hat.

FORM.notes: source note: adii 沒特別指遠近，但就是指我們知道的那裡

S.FORM: adii tamuungan hai manauaz.
adii tamuungan hai manauaz.
S.TRANSL: 這頂帽子很漂亮。
This hat is beautiful.

FORM.notes: annotation codes removed; consult the NTU Formosan Corpus source

S.FORM: takna Subali hai nii tu minsuma at punahtunganku saia aip tu hanian sia kakaunancin.
S.PHON: takna suba[l|ɬ]i [x|χ]ai nii tu minsuma at puna[x|χ]tuŋanku saia aip tu [x|χ]anian ɕia kakaunanʨin
S.FORM: takna Subali hai nii tu minsuma at punahtunganku saia aip tu hanian sia kakaunancin.

The one that did not come yesterday is eating in this restaurant.

FORM.notes: source note: pun=歷時 (年)

S.FORM: niiik haiap tu punpia mabananaz mais mahtuin min'amu malahtangia.

I don't know how many (years) will Bunun boys have to have when they can participate in the Ear-Shooting ceremony.

FORM.notes: source note: ma-ciun= 30, ciun=三

S.FORM: nadadu punciun tu painsanan.
nadadu punciun tu painsanan.
S.TRANSL: 大概3歲。
About three years old.

S.FORM: haiapik mas minsusuma kusia asangcin mapasnanava tu uvavaz.

I remember the students who came to the village.

I don't forget the students who came to this village.

I remember the day when those students came to our village.

S.FORM: haiapik tu hinudas mas davus.
haiapik tu hinudas mas davus.

I know that the person who drank alcohol is you.

The person who forgot to write his/her homework must do more effort.

S.FORM: sipungulik mas isaicia sinsaivku tu dingua.

S.FORM: sipungulik mas isaicia sinsaivku tu dingua.

I forgot the telephone number he gave to me.

It is said that monkeys are transformed by gluttonous people.

Someone says that the teacher is going to go abroad for one year.

I heard that he said this month will be very hot.

FORM.notes: source note: 我的話就不會用dau，意思怪

S.FORM: maza sain tu maibabu masa paciduanku hai mazaum at haiapik tu minpuuhin.

S.FORM: maza sain tu maibabu masa paciduanku hai mazaum at haiapik tu minpuuhin.

S.FORM: cinhaiap tu aiza iv'iv kulumah.
cinhaiap tu aiza iv'iv kulumah.

I feel that the wind is blowing into the house.

FORM.notes: source note: dau指「對方跟我說的事情(約80%確信度)」。ta’az=ik=dau ... 別人說我聽過...

S.FORM: ta'azik tu aizadau tacini bunun ashaili kungadah sia libus.

S.FORM: ta'azik tu aizadau tacini bunun ashaili kungadah sia libus.
S.PHON: taʔaðik tu aiðadau taʨini bunun as[x|χ]ai[l|ɬ]i kuŋada[x|χ] ɕia [l|ɬ]ibus
S.TRANSL: 我聽到說是有一個人帶著一把刀走進森林。

S.FORM: ta'azaanindau hazamikit tu'ia.
ta'azaanindau hazamikit tu'ia.

S.TRANSL: 那是布農族人居住的地方。
That's where the Bunun people live.

FORM.notes: source note: mapahainan 和 pishasibangan 都是遊戲的地方，可以互換。

S.FORM: saia hai dadangian mas itu mabananaz pahainanan.
S.PHON: saia [x|χ]ai dadaŋian mas itu mabananað pa[x|χ]ainanan
S.FORM: saia hai dadangian mas itu mabananaz pahainanan.
S.PHON: saia [x|χ]ai dadaŋian mas itu mabananað pa[x|χ]ainanan
S.TRANSL: 那是男孩們玩遊戲的地方。
That's where the boys play games.

FORM.notes: source note: piskazavan 是讓(東西)回冷的地方，也就是冰箱。pisbahaisan是讓(東西)回熱的地方。

S.FORM: 'aizaang tu kauman halup isia piskazavan.
'aizaang tu kauman halup isia piskazavan.
S.TRANSL: 還有一些桃子在冰箱裡。
There are still a few peaches in the refrigerator.

S.FORM: andipaun tu 'uvaaz hai ingadah sia cina tu kat'uvaazan.
S.PHON: andipaun tu ʔuvaað [x|χ]ai iŋada[x|χ] ɕia ʨina tu katʔuvaaðan
S.FORM: andipaun tu 'uvaaz hai ingadah sia cina tu kat'uvaazan.
S.PHON: andipaun tu ʔuvaað [x|χ]ai iŋada[x|χ] ɕia ʨina tu katʔuvaaðan
S.TRANSL: 媽媽的子宮裡有一個孩子。
There is a child in Mom's uterus.

FORM.notes: source note: mahulpiahan tu silup 腸子胖的部位，就是大腸(large intestine)。mahulpiah 才有胖的意思, makuis才有瘦的意思matukulaz 動物瘦 makuisan tu silup 腸子瘦的部位，就是小腸(small intestine)。

S.FORM: niiik mamaun mas mahulpiahan mas makuisan tu silup.
S.PHON: niiik mamaun mas ma[x|χ]u[l|ɬ]pia[x|χ]an mas makuisan tu ɕi[l|ɬ]up
S.FORM: niiik mamaun mas mahulpiahan mas makuisan tu silup.
S.PHON: niiik mamaun mas ma[x|χ]u[l|ɬ]pia[x|χ]an mas makuisan tu ɕi[l|ɬ]up
S.TRANSL: 我不吃大腸和小腸。
I don't eat large or small intestines.

S.FORM: balivusan nii tu mimis'u maltluvgtluv.
balivusan nii tu mimis'u maltluvgtluv.
S.TRANSL: 颱風吹不停。
The typhoon does not stop blowing.

FORM.notes: source note: hanian在本句為『今天』。luvluvan aip dihanin=an 今天的天氣有風*luvluvan aip dihanin=tan 所以是處焦！

S.FORM: luvluvanta hanian.
luvluvanta hanian.
S.TRANSL: (lit.) 我們今天刮風。
It's windy today.

FORM.notes: source note: 此處 “… tu hanian” 結構所指的是『…的一天』。本句不是只今天，可以是明天，後天，或是任一天。hanian 在本句為『天』。

S.FORM: luvluvan tu hanian.
luvluvan tu hanian.
S.TRANSL: 有風的一天。

TRANSL.notes: source translation commentary: It's a windy day. (This refers to tomorrow or days afterwards.)

S.TRANSL: It's a windy day.

FORM.notes: source note: “punal” 可以指土石流或是洪水。ning’av 海 laning’av 洪水

S.FORM: punal hai nii tu mimis'u laltpugtpunal.
punal hai nii tu mimis'u laltpugtpunal.
S.TRANSL: 土石流不停地沖。
The landslide doe not stop washing

FORM.notes: source note: “lihai” 是來自日文的外來語『礼拝』(レイハイ, /reihai/ )

S.FORM: sian hai dangianta lihai.
sian hai dangianta lihai.
S.TRANSL: 這是做禮拜的地方。
Here is where the (Christian) service takes place.

FORM.notes: source note: 此句的 “laupaku” 也可以用 “laupakadau” 取代。 “laupaku” 詞尾的 “ku”沒有意義，在此也不是詞綴。

S.FORM: laupaku tu buan hai islunghuan tu buan.
laupaku tu buan hai islunghuan tu buan.
S.TRANSL: 這個月是休假月。
This month is the resting month.

FORM.notes: source note: “islunhuan”這裡也可以被“islunhu”取代。

S.FORM: niiik mazima mais islunghuan tu hanian.
niiik mazima mais islunghuan tu hanian.
S.TRANSL: 我不喜歡假期。
I don't like holidays.

S.FORM: inak andingalan hai masial tu bunun.
inak andingalan hai masial tu bunun.
S.TRANSL: 我的鄰居是個好心人。
My neighbor is a kind person.

S.FORM: adii isltnagtnavaan hai inak tu andingalan.
adii isltnagtnavaan hai inak tu andingalan.
S.TRANSL: 那個學生是我的鄰居。
That student is my neighbor.

FORM.notes: source note: “pisvangdu” 指的是偏向基督教式的禱告。

S.FORM: niiik asa kudii muampuk pisvangdu.
niiik asa kudii muampuk pisvangdu.
S.TRANSL: 我不想去(參加)禱告會。
I do not want to go to the the praying gathering.

FORM.notes: source note: 『聚集的人群』是 “Bunun muampuk” 也可以說 “muampuk Bunun”。

S.FORM: adiia hai supah bunun muampuk.
adiia hai supah bunun muampuk.

That is where many people gather together.

W.TRANSL: 可見.遠距-那裡=遠距.主格

FORM.notes: source note: “udinunan” 和 “uampukan” 可以互相換用。mudinuun 來自四面八方的人聚集pudinunun isnanavaan a mas masnanava cia 老師把學生集中起來

S.FORM: adiia hai udinunan bunun.
adiia hai udinunan bunun.
S.TRANSL: 那是聚會的地方。
That is where people gather.

W.TRANSL: 可見.遠距-那裡=遠距.主格

FORM.notes: source note: “masumsum” 和 “pisvangtu” 禱告雖然都有禱告的意思, 但是 “masumsum” 指的是非基督教式的拜拜。

S.FORM: niiik asa kudii masumsuman.
niiik asa kudii masumsuman.
S.TRANSL: 我不想去(參加)拜拜大會。
I don't want to go to the place where many people worship.

S.FORM: susumsumanan hai imita.
susumsumanan hai imita.
S.TRANSL: 這是我們拜拜(拜神)的地方。
This is where we worship (god).

S.FORM: dangianan hai imita.
dangianan hai imita.
S.TRANSL: 這個住的地方是我們的。
This (place) is where we live.

andiiptan inak.
S.TRANSL: 我的是這個。
That (thing) is (specifically) mine.

masial sain tu iliskinun.
S.TRANSL: 想的東西很好。

S.TRANSL: 那是和我們一起做事的人。

saia hai manaskalan tu dangian.

saia hai kanaskalun tu dangian.

hanimulmulan hai inak a is'aang.

FORM.notes: source note: 布農語的『西邊』要用 “uhaivan-vali”(太陽翻跨過去之地)表示。『西邊』也可以用 “uhaivan tu vali” 表示，只是說法上嫌麻煩，多省略。

vali hai muhaiv sia uhaivasvali.

FORM.notes: source note: Minhamisan字面意思為『變成冬天的時候』，布農族人的新年在十月份，也就是季節轉變成冬天時。

S.TRANSL: 我不想去參加新年祭 (Minhamisan)。

supah bunun hai isia pasinapan.

nahanup tu tus'a hai taunadiipin.

S.FORM: tas tu painsanan hai musipatun mapauvaiv tus'a.

S.FORM: talabal hai mamaklang.
talabal hai mamaklang.

naminhamisan.

FORM.notes: source note: 布農族語原無春天用字，目前以“namintalabal”表示，意為『即將變夏天的時候』。

namintalabalan.
